Method of Attack: Exploits a flaw in the speculative execution process of AMD Zen 2 CPUs, allowing attackers to access data from vector registers (YMM registers) during speculative execution without elevated privileges.
Impacted Systems: AMD Ryzen 4000 Series Processors with Radeon Graphics
AMD Ryzen 5000 Series Processors with Radeon Graphics
AMD Ryzen 7020 Series Processors with Radeon Graphics
Attack Vector: Speculative execution vulnerability in vector registers (YMM registers)
